==Biography==
Adrian "'''CandyPanda'''" Wübbelmann is a League of Legends player from a town near Cologne, Germany. His first gaming experience came at a relatively late age as he started playing Counter-Strike at age 15. He would play DotA and Counter-Strike for fun, until a friend introduced him to the free-to-play League of Legends. He thought of LoL as a sequel to DotA, and he registered one month after the beta.

===2015 Season===
CandyPanda rejoined SK Gaming, for the second time, ahead of the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Summer Season|LCS Summer Split]].<ref>[http://www.sk-gaming.com/content/1845347-CandyPanda_rejoins_SK_Gamings_LCS_roster CandyPanda rejoins SK Gaming's LCS roster] ''sk-gaming.com''</ref>

The [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Summer Season|Summer Season]] was not a success for CandyPanda and the team, ultimately finishing the regular season in 9th place. This meant that they would have to fight for their LCS status in the [[League Championship Series/Europe/2016 Season/Spring Promotion|2016 Spring Promotion]], where they faced [[Gamers2]]. A well-fought series eventually saw [[SK Gaming]], who had been a part of the European LCS since it's conception, lose their place in the LCS.

== Trivia ==
* On the origins of his summoner name, he had this to say: "Panda was already taken so I had to add something, since I didn't want the generic Xx or whatever you may use I choose Candy, no idea why. I use 'Fennec' as nick sometimes too since fennecs are cool!" <ref>[http://www.sk-gaming.com/content/52641-Getting_to_know_SKCandyPanda Getting to know SK|CandyPanda] ''sk-gaming.com''</ref>
* His motto is '''"If you do something, do it perfectly."'''
* Known for his {{ci|Tristana}} early in his career.
* Refused to be on a separate team than [[Nyph]] until he temporarily left SK.
* Has a pet hamster named {{ci|Teemo}}.
* Likes to practice karting or paintball in his spare time.
* Likes Asian food, thinks water is awesome (favorite drink).
* Favorite movies are [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0110912/?ref_=sr_1 Pulp Fiction] and [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0454848/ Inside Man.]
* Likes all sorts of music as long as it's the best of its genre, mostly listens to house music.
